items: Changing a rung template `EncWarlock0{2–7}TemplateNecro` also needs that rung's boss template `EncWarlock0NTemplateBossNecro` (7 · 14 · 21 · 30 · 40 · 50, on *Warlock Bosses*), which uses it as its template but not for `Stats`. The CC rung templates `ccVSVSSE003_EncWarlock0{2–6}TemplateNecro` 00091D · 00091C · 00091B · 00091A · 000919 (6 · 12 · 19 · 27 · 36, ccvsvsse003-necroarts.esl; templates of nothing else, so not rows) carry the CC boss templates `…0{2–6}TemplateBossNecro` 000922 · 000921 · 000920 · 00091F · 00091E (on *Warlock Bosses*) the same way.

Changing `EncWarlock04TemplateNecro` 0551AD also needs `ccBGSSSE045_LushakgraRagdam` 000835:ccbgssse045-hasedoki.esl (PC×1.25 [10–20]); `EncWarlock07TemplateNecro` 1091AB also needs `ccBGSSSE045_IvaraofOlenveld` 000832:ccbgssse045-hasedoki.esl (PC×1.25 [15–40]); both on *Named Warlocks*: same pattern.

Changing `EncWarlock00Template` 044CCC (the shared base of every rung template, which uses it without `Stats`) also needs `WIChangeLocation04Student` 06F214 (1, left out as not an enemy on the *Warlocks* group page): same pattern.

Every other record here (the rung leaves, every Necromancer wrapper, Fort Snowhawk, the Southfringe boss and Spellswords, the MS06 cultists and `dunPOIChickenNecromander`) carries `Stats` and follows its template or list.
